mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, fingerprint, description, source, updated_at AS updatedAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM emoji_mapping WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, fingerprint, description, source, updated_at AS updatedAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM emoji_mapping WHERE platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND group_id = #{groupId} AND fingerprint = #{fingerprint}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emoji_mapping (platform, bot_id, group_id, fingerprint, description, source) VALUES (#{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{fingerprint}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{source}, 'vision')) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE description = VALUES (description), source = VALUES (source)
